name: ngao-seasonal-v3
issue_point: end of September (Aug-Sep SST, Jul-Sep wind and pressure)

features.dmi: Indian Ocean Dipole: WIO minus EIO SST (degC)
features.u850_ceio: Central equatorial Indian Ocean 850 hPa zonal wind, Jul-Sep (m/s)
features.slp_grad: East minus west Indian Ocean sea-level pressure, Jul-Sep (hPa)

regions.method: k-means (k=6) on standardised 1981-2015 OND CHIRPS anomaly series per ward; ids ordered south to north; a ward takes the region of the nearest training ward centroid

data.sst: NOAA ERSSTv5 monthly (PSL sst.mnmean.nc for training; NCEI ersst.v5.YYYYMM.nc live)
data.atmosphere: NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis 1 monthly u850 and SLP (training; discontinued March 2026); ERA5 live
data.labels: CHIRPS v2.0 Africa monthly 1981-2025; GPCC Full Data v2020 1951-1980
data.wards: geoBoundaries KEN ADM3, 1452 wards (188 use their centroid pixel)

caveats: All wards in a season move together, so the 2016-2025 test is effectively 10 seasons: the AUC confidence interval is wide and gains over simpler models are directional, not proven. June-September ocean conditions did not explain the wet seasons of 2020, 2022, 2024 and 2025. Decision support next to the official KMD / ICPAC outlook, not a replacement.

y25.target_desc: OND rainfall > 125% of the ward's 1991-2020 OND mean

yter.target_desc: OND rainfall above the ward's 1991-2020 upper tercile (KMD 'above normal')

sst4.label: SST-only (live while NCEP R1 is discontinued)

y25.target_desc: OND rainfall > 125% of the ward's 1991-2020 OND mean

yter.target_desc: OND rainfall above the ward's 1991-2020 upper tercile (KMD 'above normal')
